practice_questions.text:
Analysts must query warehouse tables with T-SQL but must never read the underlying Parquet files with
Spark. Which combination do you grant?

You must hide the Salary  column from all roles except HR, enforced identically for Spark, T-SQL, and a
Direct Lake model. Which feature?

A lakehouse table is 900 GB and grows daily. Reports must be near real time and fast. Which storage
mode?

A Direct Lake report worked for months and is now consistently slow. Queries are hitting the SQL
analytics endpoint. What happened?

You need YTD, PY, and YoY variants of 20 measures without writing 60 measures. What do you
implement?

A business user must switch a chart between three different measures from a slicer. What do you
implement?

Which two objects can you create in a lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint: view, stored procedure, inline
TVF, MERGE  statement?
A dataflow suddenly takes ten times longer after adding a step. What is the most likely cause?

You must promote a tested set of items from Test to Production and re-point them at the Production
lakehouse. Which two features?
What exactly happens when a Direct Lake semantic model is "refreshed"?
Sales must be analysed by both order date and ship date against a single date dimension. How?

You need to know every report that breaks if you drop a column from a Gold warehouse table. Which
feature?
Which endorsement level can only be applied by reviewers the tenant admin nominates?
A KQL query must return the ten devices with the most errors. Which operator?
An Import model refresh takes 6 hours; only the last 7 days of data ever change. What do you configure?
A slicer over a small dimension on a DirectQuery model is slow. What is the standard fix?
Which Fabric store supports multi-table transactions with T-SQL writes?
What does turning on OneLake availability for an eventhouse achieve?
Which file format lets a report and its semantic model be code-reviewed in a pull request?
A measure divides two measures and errors when the denominator is zero. What do you use?

chapter_selfchecks.text:
An analyst must run T-SQL queries against a warehouse but must not read files with Spark. What do you
grant?

Where do you configure a rule that hides the Salary  column from everyone except HR, enforced for
Spark and SQL and Direct Lake?
A user can open a report but cannot create a new one from the same semantic model. What is missing?
Who is allowed to mark a semantic model as Certified?
Why does a workspace Member still see all rows despite an RLS role being defined?
You need per-stage lakehouse bindings for ten notebooks. Rules on every item, or a variable library?

A developer wants two people reviewing measure changes before they reach the shared model. Which
feature?
What is lost when you deploy a warehouse through a deployment pipeline?
Which tool adds object-level security to a semantic model?
Analysts each need the same report against their own regional database. Which asset do you publish?

A nightly load from an on-premises SQL Server needs to reach a lakehouse. What is required beyond a
pipeline?

The finance team wants Gold tables from the Sales workspace without duplicating them. What do you
create?

A team needs Power BI reports over telemetry that lives in an eventhouse, with Direct Lake. What must
be enabled?
Which discovery surface lists existing eventstreams?

A source database must appear in Fabric within seconds of a change, with no ETL to maintain. What do
you choose?

A dataflow that ran in 3 minutes now takes 40. The only change was an added custom column early in
the query. What happened?
You need an auto-incrementing surrogate key in a Fabric warehouse dimension. What do you use?

Which object cannot be created in a lakehouse SQL analytics endpoint: view, inline TVF, or stored
procedure?
How do you keep only the most recent row per business key?

A date column arrives as text and 0.3% of values are malformed. How do you load the good rows without
failing the batch?
A model needs YTD, PY, and YoY for 14 measures. What do you build?
Users want to switch a chart between Sales, Margin, and Quantity from a slicer. What do you build?
Two date columns must both filter one date dimension. How?
A slicer on a DirectQuery model is painfully slow, but the dimension is small. What do you change?
Why must a Direct Lake model use large semantic model storage format?
Performance Analyzer shows 90 ms DAX and 4,500 ms visual display. What do you fix?
A Direct Lake report suddenly slowed with no model change. What do you check first?
Which model property makes a guardrail breach raise an error instead of degrading?
Your incremental refresh runs as long as a full refresh. What is the likely cause?
You must combine Gold tables from two different lakehouses in one Direct Lake model. Which flavour?
